87e194e1bc6d32be.description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the Role
We’re looking for a leader to own our legal operations function and continue building it for our next phase of growth. Working with a dedicated automations engineering team, you will own the systems that ensure the Legal Team scales with the company: contract management, vendor relationships (including outside counsel billing and guidelines) and the overall legal tech stack. The goal is simple: help define what a legal organization looks like in the AI native era.
In this role, you will:
• 
Assist in the design and improvement of the operating model for Legal. Identify work that should be handled by the team and areas where we can continue automating.
• 
Manage our legal technology stack, including contract lifecycle management (Ironclad), matter management, and creating an e-billing systems
• 
Manage relationships with outside counsel and legal service providers, including budget and performance tracking
• 
Work with our automation teams to use Eleven Agents and other tools to change the way work is done across the team
• 
Define metrics and build dashboards that give us a clear view of the team's priorities, workload and performance
• 
Partner with Finance, IT, FDE and business teams to keep legal processes aligned with how the company operates
Who you are:
• 
You are a strategist and an operator. You are incredibly intellectually curious and enjoy breaking down and rebuilding processes
• 
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive - you’re comfortable juggling multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy
• 
Genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies.
• 
A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams
• 
Comfortable working independently in a distributed, high-trust environment
• 
You have previous experience at a high-growth technology or AI company
What you bring:
• 
7+ years of experience in legal operations with some experience leading the function
• 
Deep expertise in legal technology, including CLM platforms (Ironclad a major plus), e-billing systems, and matter management tools
• 
Experience supporting global teams
• 
Strong analytical skills with experience gathering metrics to storytell and drive key business decisions
• 
Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage competing deadlines.
Location
This role is remote and can be executed anywhere in the United States.
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
Compensation: $80K – $130K • Offers Equity

870752321de87f92.description:
We are looking for a CRM executive to support the execution and day-to-day operations of customer engagement and retention campaigns across multiple communication channels. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in CRM campaign execution, audience management, campaign QA, journey monitoring, and reporting. The role requires strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously. The candidate will work closely with the retention marketing, martech, data, product, and business teams to ensure accurate, timely, and effective customer communication across two brands.

Key Responsibilities: 

A. CRM campaign execution:
1. Support the end-to-end execution of CRM campaigns across multiple channels, including push notifications, email, WhatsApp, RCS, and in-app messaging
2. Set up campaigns and customer journeys based on campaign briefs and defined requirements
3. Ensure campaigns are launched accurately and within agreed timelines
4. Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while maintaining execution quality

B. Audience management & validation:
1. Create, upload, validate, and manage campaign audiences and customer segments
2. Cross-check audience criteria against campaign requirements before campaign launch
3. Perform data validation and identify discrepancies in audience counts or customer attributes
4. Coordinate with data and martech teams to resolve audience-related issues

C. Campaign QA & quality control:
1. Conduct thorough pre-launch QA of campaign content, targeting, scheduling, links, personalization, and channel configurations
2. Validate deep links, UTM parameters, tracking tags, and campaign parameters wherever applicable
3. Ensure communication content is correctly configured across different devices and channels
4. Identify and report campaign errors before launch to minimize operational issues

D. Customer journey monitoring:
1. Monitor automated CRM journeys and campaign performance after launch
2. Track journey entry, delivery, engagement, conversion, and drop-off metrics
3. Identify failed journeys, delivery issues, or unexpected customer behavior
4. Escalate technical or platform-related issues to the appropriate teams and ensure timely resolution

E. Campaign reporting & analysis:
1. Prepare regular campaign performance reports and dashboards
2. Track key metrics such as delivery rate, open/click rate, engagement rate, conversion rate, unsubscribe/opt-out rate, campaign revenue, and customer retention
3. Maintain campaign trackers and execution reports
4. Provide basic insights and observations to the Retention Marketing Manager

F. Cross-functional coordination:
1. Coordinate with retention marketing, martech, data analytics, product, creative, and technology teams for campaign execution
2. Understand campaign briefs and translate requirements into accurate campaign setups
3. Follow up on dependencies to ensure campaigns are launched on time
4. Maintain proper documentation of campaign configurations, results, and learnings

G. Campaign operations & process improvement:
1. Support increasing campaign volumes across both brands while maintaining execution quality
2. Maintain campaign calendars, trackers, checklists, and operational documentation
3. Identify repetitive operational tasks and suggest opportunities for process improvement or automation
4. Follow defined CRM processes and quality standards to reduce campaign errors

Job Title: Product Manager Omnichannel CX Platform

Package: 10 lpa

Location: Mumbai (But involves extensive travel within & outside Mumbai)

Reports to: Lead - Business Development

Experience: 5--8 years (Product Management / SaaS / CX-Tech domain)

About the Role:

A fresh omnichannel CX platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the product from co-creation through to market launch, revenue generation, and P&L accountability. This is a high-autonomy, high-accountability role for someone who can operate as both a product builder and a business owner. You'll work closely with the development team to shape the product, then personally drive its go-to-market strategy, build and lead a sales team, and be accountable for revenue outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Product Co-Creation (Pre-Launch)

- Partner with the development team to define and evolve the product roadmap

- Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform feature prioritization

- Conduct ongoing competitor analysis to maintain differentiation

- Track emerging technology trends (AI, automation, omnichannel tooling) relevant to CX platforms

- Translate market needs into clear product requirements and specifications

• Go-to-Market & Lead Generation (Post-Launch)

- Identify, evaluate, and liaise with marketing agencies to design and execute lead generation campaigns

- Own positioning, messaging, and launch strategy for the product

- Monitor campaign performance and iterate on GTM approach based on results

• Sales Team Build-Out & Revenue Ownership (Scale)

- Recruit, build, and lead a dedicated sales team

- Define sales processes, targets, and enablement materials

- Own the P&L for the product line revenue targets, cost management, and profitability

- Report progress and strategic decisions to Directors while operating with full autonomy on execution

Required Qualifications

- 5 to 8 years of experience in product management, ideally within SaaS, CX-tech, or B2B software

- Demonstrated experience taking a product from development through commercial launch

- Prior exposure to building or scaling a sales function (direct experience leading a sales team is a strong plus)

- Experience working with marketing/growth agencies for demand generation

- Strong analytical skills comfortable owning revenue and P&L metrics, not just product metrics

Key Skills & Competencies

- High ownership mentality comfortable operating independently with minimal oversight

- Strong cross-functional collaboration (engineering, marketing, sales)

- Customer-centric mindset with strong synthesis skills (feedback roadmap)

- Commercial acumen understands unit economics, CAC/LTV, sales pipeline management

- Excellent stakeholder communication, particularly upward to Directors

Success Metrics:

- Product launch timeline adherence

- Lead volume/quality generated post-launch

- Sales team ramp-up and revenue attainment vs. target

- Product P&L profitability
